# SteadyStack

> Multi-region uptime monitoring that requires quorum consensus across 7 global regions before alerting. Free tier: 50 monitors, 3-minute checks, commercial use allowed. Open-source, self-hostable, with public status pages, SSL/DNS/heartbeat monitoring, and Terraform/CI/CD integrations.

## Docs

Product documentation: setup, architecture, alerting, and API reference.

- [Introduction](https://steadystack.dev/docs/introduction): Edge-native synthetic surveillance and zero-false-positive uptime monitoring.
- [Getting Started](https://steadystack.dev/docs/quickstart): Copy-paste your way from zero to a monitored endpoint with alerts and a status page — dashboard, CLI, API, or Terraform.
- [Monitors](https://steadystack.dev/docs/monitors): Comprehensive guide to HTTP, PING, PORT, SSL, DNS, and Heartbeat synthetic surveillance.
- [Response Assertions & Payload Validation](https://steadystack.dev/docs/response-assertions): Define expectations on HTTP status codes, body text, JSON paths, and regex patterns to catch silent 200 OK failures.
- [Quorum Consensus](https://steadystack.dev/docs/quorum-consensus): How 4-of-7 multi-region edge verification eliminates false positives.
- [Dynamic Thresholding](https://steadystack.dev/docs/dynamic-thresholding): AI-driven latency anomaly learning and degradation detection.
- [Network Architecture & Out-of-Band Sentinel](https://steadystack.dev/docs/network-architecture): How 7 sovereign edge clusters and independent Hetzner hardware eradicate global blind spots.
- [Alert Rules](https://steadystack.dev/docs/alert-rules): Configure conditional incident routing, triggers, and threshold evaluations.
- [Alert Channels Setup](https://steadystack.dev/docs/alert-channels): Step-by-step setup for every notification channel: email, Slack, Discord, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, Telegram, SMS, and custom webhooks.
- [Integrations](https://steadystack.dev/docs/integrations): Connect SteadyStack to PagerDuty, Opsgenie, Slack, Discord, Telegram, and Webhooks.
- [Incident Runbooks & Postmortems](https://steadystack.dev/docs/incident-runbooks): Equip on-call engineers with instant runbook links and automated postmortem summaries.
- [Hosted Status Pages](https://steadystack.dev/docs/status-pages): Build public and private cyberpunk-themed status pages with custom domains.
- [Customizing Status Pages](https://steadystack.dev/docs/status-page-customization): Themes, branding, custom domains, SEO, access control, localization, and per-monitor display options for hosted status pages.
- [Status Badges & Widgets](https://steadystack.dev/docs/status-badges): Embed dynamic real-time SVG status badges in your READMEs, dashboards, and websites.
- [SLA & Audit Reports](https://steadystack.dev/docs/sla-reports): SLA availability mathematics, maintenance window exclusions, and SOC2 audit exports.
- [Teams & RBAC](https://steadystack.dev/docs/teams-rbac): Invite teammates, assign roles, and control who can edit monitors, view incidents, and manage billing.
- [SLA Calculation Methodology](https://steadystack.dev/docs/sla-methodology): How SteadyStack computes SLA ratios, uptime percentages, and what counts as downtime — exactly.
- [Monitoring as Code](https://steadystack.dev/docs/monitoring-as-code): Define monitors in steadystack.yaml, review diffs, and apply them idempotently with the pulse CLI — GitOps for your uptime checks.
- [Terraform / OpenTofu Provider](https://steadystack.dev/docs/terraform): Manage synthetic surveillance, alert routing rules, and status pages as code.
- [GitHub Actions CI/CD Gates](https://steadystack.dev/docs/github-actions): Block broken deployments and automate synthetic smoke tests in GitHub Actions workflows.
- [CLI & Docker Probes](https://steadystack.dev/docs/cli): Inspect live surveillance in the terminal and deploy custom on-premise Docker probe nodes.
- [CLI Command Reference](https://steadystack.dev/docs/cli-reference): Complete command reference for the pulse CLI — auth, monitors, apply/diff, trigger, logs, wait, and import.
- [Self-Hosting & Docker Deployments](https://steadystack.dev/docs/self-hosting): Deploy SteadyStack on your own servers or run private VPC probes with Docker Compose.
- [Deploying Private Probes](https://steadystack.dev/docs/probe-deployment): Run SteadyStack probe agents inside your VPC with Docker Compose or the Kubernetes Helm chart — exact env vars, values, and examples.
- [REST API Reference](https://steadystack.dev/docs/api-reference): Programmatic REST API v1 for monitors, alert channels, alert rules, status pages, regions, and instant multi-region probes — with request and response examples for every endpoint.
- [Webhook Signatures & Payloads](https://steadystack.dev/docs/webhooks): Verify HMAC-SHA256 signatures and process automated incident notification payloads.
- [Prometheus & Grafana Observability](https://steadystack.dev/docs/prometheus-grafana): Scrape SteadyStack latency, availability, and uptime metrics into Prometheus, Datadog, or Grafana.
